validated_results.title: Critique of the U-shaped serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D level-disease response relation.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative critique of published serum 25(OH)D literature including preliminary meta-analyses rather than an original human study of vitamin D and incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Commentary: Serum lycopene and prostate cancer progression: a re-consideration of findings from the prostate cancer prevention trial.
validated_results.reason: The article is an interpretive commentary on a previously published trial analysis and reports no original results on serum lycopene and prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Coffee consumption and prostate cancer risk and progression in the Health Professionals Follow-up Study.
validated_results.journal: Journal of the National Cancer Institute
validated_results.reason: The measured exposure is total coffee consumption, a multi-component beverage, and no caffeine-specific estimate for prostate cancer incidence can be separated from the coffee findings.
